load coffee capsule.name: retrieve mug and capsule
load coffee capsule.definition: Take the mug and coffee capsule from storage and place them on the counter.

load coffee capsule.name: fill water tank
load coffee capsule.definition: Fill the water tank using the jug and attach it to the coffee machine.

load coffee capsule.name: prepare machine
load coffee capsule.definition: Turn on the coffee machine and open its capsule compartment handle.

load coffee capsule.name: insert capsule
load coffee capsule.definition: Place the coffee capsule into the machine and lock the handle.

load coffee capsule.name: position mug
load coffee capsule.definition: Place the mug under the nozzle of the coffee machine.

prepare milk.name: retrieve milk
prepare milk.definition: Open the fridge, take out the milk bottle, and close the fridge.

prepare milk.name: pour milk
prepare milk.definition: Open the milk bottle, pour milk into the milk frother, and close the bottle.

prepare milk.name: setup frother
prepare milk.definition: Place the center piece into the milk frother and put it on its base.

prepare milk.name: power frother
prepare milk.definition: Plug in the milk frother and turn on the socket power.

add frothed milk.name: pick up frother
add frothed milk.definition: Take the milk frother from its base on the countertop.

add frothed milk.name: settle milk
add frothed milk.definition: Tap the milk frother on the countertop to set the frothed milk.

add frothed milk.name: pour frothed milk
add frothed milk.definition: Tilt the milk frother to pour frothed milk into the mug.

stir and clean.name: stir coffee
stir and clean.definition: Take a wooden stirrer and mix the coffee and frothed milk in the mug.

stir and clean.name: discard stirrer
stir and clean.definition: Throw the used wooden stirrer into the trash bin and close the bin.

stir and clean.name: rinse frother
stir and clean.definition: Turn the milk frother upside down under the open tap to wash it.

stir and clean.name: wipe and dry
stir and clean.definition: Use the sponge to clean surfaces and dry hands with the towel.
